title: Shield’s formula for self-cleansing velocity

symbols.definition: Dimensionless constant with a value of about 0.04 to start motion of granular particles and about 0.8 for adequate self cleansing of sewers

applicability: To ensure that deposition of suspended solids does not take place, self-cleansing velocities using Shield’s formula is considered in the design of sewers. Specific gravity of grit is usually in the range of 2.4 to 2.65.
notes: Transcriber note: the printed particle-size unit is mm; no dimensional repair or unit conversion has been made.
